hxseparator.h File Reference

Detailed Description

This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit Separator widget API. The separator is a standard graphic primitive placed within the toolkit heirarchy, and provides a visual mechanism to group widgets.

Function Documentation

HxResult HxSeparatorDelete ( HxSeparator_t *  pSeperator  ) 

Delete a separator widget.

HxSeparatorDelete deletes a separator created from an earlier call to HxSeparatorNew.

It is not necessary to call this function when quitting the application, since the widget's parent calls this function just before the parent is deleted. HxSeparatorDelete only needs to be called when deleting a separator at runtime.

Parameters:
pSeparator IN: Pointer to the separator to delete
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

HxResult HxSeparatorNew ( uint32_t  id,
HxWidget_t *  pParent,
const HxRectangle_t *  pBounds,
HxColor_t *  pColor,
HxSeparator_t **  hSeparator 
)

Create a separator widget.

HxSeparatorNew creates a new separator widget. The application is responsible for defining the bounds of the separator

The default system color is used if pColor is NULL.

Parameters:
id IN: Unique ID for the widget, defined by app, or kHxWidgetAutoID to auto-generate the ID
pParent IN: Pointer to "parent" widget
pBounds IN: Pointer to the seaparator bounds
pColor IN: HxFont_t pointer
hSeparator OUT: Handle to the new separator; *hSeparator is NULL on failure
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful. Returns HX_MEMORY_ERROR if memory allocation fails, and sets *hSeparator to NULL.
